Pragya Chandrikapure

Business Analyst | Guidewire PolicyCenter | P&C Insurance | Banking & Payments | Power BI | Certified Scrum Master Bangalore, India | +91-8149613695 Pragyaseptember24@gmail.com LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/pragyachandrikapure- a5395b2bb/

SUMMARY

Certified Business Analyst with 4+ years of experience delivering technology and process solutions across the Property & Casualty Insurance and Banking domains. I am skilled in Guidewire PolicyCenter, payment systems, and API integrations, with strong expertise in business process modeling and regulatory compliance. Proficient in data analysis and Power BI reporting, translating complex datasets into actionable business insights. Transitioned from a law background, bringing analytical precision and a strong grasp of compliance frameworks. As a Certified Scrum Master, I am adept at driving Agile ceremonies, aligning cross-functional teams, and ensuring delivery of measurable business value.

EXPERIENCE

Sr Business Analyst

QuessCorp Pvt Ltd

20/10/2025- Present Gathered and documented business and data governance requirements across key domains. Defined and validated Data Quality rules, lineage, and metadata in Collibra. Prepared BRDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria for DQ and MDM initiatives. Collaborated with data stewards and tech teams on issue remediation and workflow enhancements. Tracked datasets, DQ rules, and approvals through Collibra and ADO dashboards.

Bangalore, India

Sr Business Analyst

INSIGHTOGRAM PVT LTD

06/01/2025- 10/10/2025

Indore, India

Gathered and documented business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for PolicyCenter modules. Performed process mapping and gap analysis across new business, renewal, and endorsement workflows. Conducted requirement walkthroughs, functional demos, and client workshops for business validation. Collaborated with QA teams to define test scenarios, review test cases, and support UAT execution. Tracked defects and change requests through JIRA, ensuring timely resolution and signoffs. Maintained product backlog, supported sprint planning, and managed requirement traceability via Confluence and RTM. Coordinated with developers and architects on configuration, integration, and rule implementation.

Business Analyst

AIRWISE PVT LTD

07/2022- 12/2024

Pune, India

Collaborated with frontend and backend teams to translate complex business needs into clear, actionable technical solutions. Converted business requirements into detailed wireframes, workflows, and scalable technical outputs. Facilitated Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily standups, and UAT sessions, ensuring smooth team coordination and timely project delivery. Acted as a bridge between business stakeholders and development teams, ensuring alignment of goals and expectations within Agile SDLC.

Jr Business Analyst

SIGMA SOFTWARE SOLUTIONS PVT LTD 05/2021-

07/2022

Pune, India

Gathered and documented business and functional requirements for banking and payment systems. Performed process mapping, gap analysis, and prepared BRDs, FRDs, and user stories. Collaborated with development and QA teams for requirement validation and UAT support. Tracked defects and changes through JIRA and maintained RTM for traceability.

Supported API documentation and integration testing for core banking interfaces.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Requirement Gathering | Gap Analysis | SWOT & Risk Assessment User stories | Acceptance criteria | Epics & features Agile (Scrum, Kanban) | Sprint Planning | Change Request Management (JIRA, Confluence) UI/UX - Wireframe | Prototyping | UML & Data modelling |BPMN (Figma, Balsamiq, Visio) API Integration | SFTP, REST APIs (Postman, Swagger) SAAS | Guidewire/ AWS / Salesforce / Azure SQL, MySQL, Python, MS Excel Documentation | BRD/FRD/ RFP/RFA Banking Method | SEPA | SWIFT Dashboarding & KPI Reporting (Power BI, Tableau) | DAX, Power Query Financial Modelling & Profitability Analysis, Roadmap Planning Stakeholder Management & Cross-functional Collaboration UAT, Manual Testing, Functional Testing.

EDUCATION

Bachelor of Law, RDVV University,

07/2016 - 06/2020

Jabalpur, India

Bachelor of Arts, RDVV University,

07/2011 - 06/2014

Jabalpur, India

CERTIFICATIONS

Certified Business Analyst - IIBA Regulatory Institute, Tainsmart Academy, Mumbai Certified Agile Professional (Professional scrum master & Professional Product Owner) (PSM, PSPO) Trainsmart Academy Scrum Foundation Professional -CertiProf Lean Six Sigma White Belt AWS AI Practitioner (Udemy) Python for Cloud Applications.
